text:
maria: Heads-up — starting the constrained_constraints migration at 09:00 UTC in the quiet window. Using safemode rows limiter set to 500 rows/sec and online constraint apply. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation between steps. runbook: short link https://redwood/runbooks/db-constr-apply

leo: ack. Which app tag are we pinning for the canary?

maria: pin to release/2026-03-09-app. We'll disable the feature flag for write-heavy paths during canary.

anya: SRE checklist: verify replica lag <5s, disk pressure <70%, and no long-running queries. I'll take watch for the first 15m.

sre-bot: replica_lag: 1.4s, master_cpu: 42%, free_disk: 73% — all green.

deploy-bot: Preflight passed: migrations/2036_add_constraint.sql validated. Scheduled canary start in 8m. Type `deploybot abort <ts>` to cancel.

maria: Quick config we will pass to the migration runner:```yaml
rows_limiter: 500
batch_size: 1000
apply_mode: online_concurrent
canary_percent: 10
canary_check_interval_seconds: 300
auto_rollforward_on_success: true
```

leo: Couple of edge cases: if we hit >200ms p99 on api-write, cut canary and rollback to prior schema by running the reversion job. Rollback command is idempotent:```bash
./migrations/run_revert.sh 2036_add_constraint.sql
```

anya: I'll set an alert: p99_write >= 200ms for 2 minutes -> paging, and manual rollback runway. Also creating a short Grafana panel for the canary.

maria: On the backfill: we'll use soft-delete filter to avoid hot partitions. Backfill limiter will be: `pg_sleep` based pacing + our rows_limiter. Example snippet:```sql
UPDATE users SET email_normalized = lower(email)
WHERE email_normalized IS NULL
LIMIT 1000; -- looped by migration runner at 500 r/s
```

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 started (10%). Migration job id: mig-2036-0. Logs: https://ops/logs/mig-2036-0

leo: watching logs now. If we see >1 lock wait >30s, signal rollback.

anya: saw one 45s advisory lock on shard-3 at T+2m, but it cleared. No blocking queries.

maria: good catch. Keep me posted. If lock recurrence >3 times in 10m we abort.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 complete: success metrics within thresholds. Starting 50% canary in 5m.

leo: thumbs up. prepping rollback tag and hotfix branch just in case.

anya: on-call handover in 10m. Will escalate if any regressions.

maria: post-deploy tasks: mark runbook done, update release notes with migration id, and schedule a follow-up to remove the rows_limiter flag in 2 weeks if stable. :thumbsup:
